text: This is an honest review. It's too expensive. One visit is enough.
The clinic is clean and pleasant. The doctor gave excellent advice. The staff at the counter were very helpful. It's conveniently located; a motorbike taxi from the main road costs 20 baht.
The doctor was kind; it didn't hurt at all.
